objective.title: Restore unchanged covering globalization under the current class alias
objective.statement: Repair recorded covering proof failure and rename only LocPathConnectedSpace to its definitionally identical current class LocallyPathConnectedSpace. Preserve all hypotheses/universes/exact normalized public types and bundled Homeomorph data. This enables retained-root final endpoint integration; downstream UnitRecognitionNext/IsometryConsumers reuse these proofs. It does not produce a universal source or discharge original Hamilton or smoothability existence.
deliverables: Existing covering APIs compile with all frozen type/axiom/data-preservation gates.
